title: About marketing messages | WhatsApp Help Center

facts.fact: Under marketing messages, the business pays for each message delivered to a chosen receiver within five days of being sent.
facts.quote: With marketing messages, you pay for each message that is delivered to a receiver you chose within five days of being sent.

facts.fact: Marketing messages let a business send customized messages to multiple people at once.
facts.quote: With marketing messages on the WhatsApp Business app, you can send customized messages to multiple people at once

facts.fact: Marketing messages reporting does not reflect receivers who have turned off read receipts.
facts.quote: This information won’t reflect receivers who have turned off read receipts

facts.fact: Marketing messages is currently available only in limited countries and may not be available to every business.
facts.quote: Marketing messages is currently available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet.

facts.fact: Marketing messages has been renamed business broadcasts in some countries.
facts.quote: Marketing messages is now business broadcasts in some countries.
